wire.t: Kraft for Cash leads Asian Jim 89.30 to 84.06 going into Chargers at Ravens tonight, the only Week 10 matchup still open. BTaylor1 has Zay Flowers left; ManicOrientals has Omarion Hampton, Tre' Harris and Justice Hill. Baltimore is a 4.5-point favorite with a 38.5 total.

Christian McCaffrey caught touchdowns of 74 and 66 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win at Dallas and scored 50.3 for Hold My DK. On the other side, George Pickens caught three touchdowns (40.0 for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix) and Dak Prescott threw five (45.42 for Bourbon Lover).

Patrick Mahomes threw five touchdowns at Atlanta (45.92 for Hold My DK), two of them to rookie Emmett Johnson, who ran for 101 yards in his first start. Catfan94 moved Johnson into the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix lineup and got 34.6.

Drake Maye left the Patriots' 35-10 loss to Detroit in Munich with an ankle injury on New England's opening drive. He's listed Out on Sleeper this morning. Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 153 yards and two scores for Detroit.
The Jets lost Geno Smith to an ankle injury in the third quarter of a 31-12 loss to Buffalo, and rookie Omar Cooper Jr. hurt his ankle on New York's first offensive play. Both were OBJAY starters.
Chuba Hubbard had 172 yards from scrimmage and two touchdowns in Carolina's 20-17 win at New Orleans. He scored 35.7 on the Hold My DK bench.
Kirk Cousins threw two touchdowns in his first game back with Minnesota, a 30-10 win at Green Bay, with Jordan Addison out injured. Cousins scored 19.38 on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench.
Joe Burrow threw for 409 yards and four touchdowns against Pittsburgh on Sunday night, 41.16 for The Champ. Aaron Rodgers scored 18.62 for Hold My DK in the loss.

stories.title: One game left: Kraft for Cash leads Asian Jim by 5.24, and the projections say it's a coin flip
stories.dek: Zay Flowers against Omarion Hampton, Tre' Harris and Justice Hill. Sleeper projects 102.67 to 103.72.
body: Five of the six Week 10 games are done for all practical purposes. The one that isn't: Kraft for Cash 89.30, Asian Jim 84.06, with Chargers at Ravens tonight deciding it. BTaylor1 has one player left, Zay Flowers, projected for 13.37. ManicOrientals has three: Omarion Hampton (7.20), Tre' Harris (6.17) and Justice Hill (6.29). Add it up and Sleeper has Asian Jim winning 103.72 to 102.67. That's a 1.05-point projected margin on a game that opened with Kraft for Cash as an 18.5-point favorite.

How'd it get here? CeeDee Lamb had 18.2 and DJ Moore 17.9, and then it dries up. Bryce Young scored 8.1, Kyren Williams 4.7 and Travis Kelce 5.5. Justin Herbert is on the Kraft for Cash bench and plays tonight. He was expected to play after negative imaging on his non-throwing hand, so starting Young was a defensible call. It's just one that might cost a game.

Asian Jim got 31.6 from Jaxon Smith-Njigba, including a 71-yard touchdown from Drew Lock, and ManicOrientals pulled Ladd McConkey (Out, back) for Tre' Harris before kickoff. If Asian Jim wins it's 5‑5 and right in the race for the sixth playoff spot. If Kraft for Cash wins it's 7‑3 and tied with Catfan94’s Farm Team.

Everything else is settled. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix 232.54, Jefferson’s Reserve 134.62. Hold My DK 179.84, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 78.92. The Champ 166.08, Dude, Your Getting a Dell 55.80, and Jacoby Brissett would need 110.28 tonight to flip it. Catfan94’s Farm Team 138.94, OBJAY 83.62. I Chase Brown Kids 124.46, Bourbon Lover 116.92.

stories.title: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix drops 232.54, the second-highest score in league history
stories.dek: Catfan94 now owns both 230-point weeks this league has ever seen. The pregame line was 41.4. He won by 97.92.
body: Catfan94 scored 243.58 in Week 5. Yesterday he scored 232.54. Nobody else in league history has cleared 198.64. Jahmyr Gibbs had 45.2, George Pickens 40.0, Emmett Johnson 34.6, Ja'Marr Chase 32.1, Isaiah Likely 29.7 and Josh Allen 25.34. That's six players over 25 in one week.

The Emmett Johnson part is the one that should hurt. Yesterday's edition had Johnson on the bench. Catfan94 put him in the lineup, Kansas City gave him his first start with Kenneth Walker III Out, and he caught two touchdowns from Patrick Mahomes. Meanwhile Jordan Love got sacked eight times and scored 12.8 in the superflex spot, and it didn't matter at all.

Brock Bowers left the Raiders' loss with a right ankle injury after 4.8 points. That's the one thing to watch for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, which is going to be 9‑1 and has I Chase Brown Kids next week. Ryan Flournoy scored 17.1 on the bench and Ollie Gordon II 15.5. The bench alone would've beaten Dude, Your Getting a Dell.
Jefferson’s Reserve didn't play badly. Trevor Lawrence had 34.28 and C.J. Stroud 26.94, and jmello16 scored 134.62, the fifth-best score of the week. It lost by 97.92. jmello16 is going to be 5‑5.

stories.title: Dude, Your Getting a Dell is going to be 0‑10, and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte and Bourbon Lover are going to be 3‑7
stories.dek: I Chase Brown Kids beat Bourbon Lover by 7.54 and climbs out. I scored 78.92. Let's get into it.
body: I'll start with me. StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte scored 78.92 against Hold My DK's 179.84. Parker Washington had 27.2 and nobody else cleared 12. Tyler Allgeier started at running back and scored 1.9 while Samaje Perine scored 13.9 on my bench. Drake Maye left on New England's first drive with an ankle injury, and he's Out on Sleeper this morning. With Jalen Hurts on IR, my quarterbacks behind him are Justin Fields and Shedeur Sanders on the taxi squad. In a superflex league. Next week is The Champ.

I Chase Brown Kids beat Bourbon Lover 124.46 to 116.92 to get to 4‑6. Jayden Daniels had 27.76, Chase Brown 26.8 at superflex and Blake Corum 22.9. Cam Ward scored 24.14 on the bench. ZachCarroll09 had a 16.7-point line and won by 7.54, so paknight12 covered and still lost.

Bourbon Lover got 45.42 from Dak Prescott, 22.4 from Tony Pollard and 22.1 from Drew Lock, and lost anyway because Devin Singletary scored 0.3 and Demarcus Robinson 0.0 in the lineup. paknight12 will be 3‑7 and has given up the most points in the league.

Dude, Your Getting a Dell scored 55.80. Deebo Samuel's 70-yard reverse touchdown got him to 26.9 and Stefon Diggs had 17.8. Xavier Worthy caught zero of three targets. Br0phy owns both Jacoby Brissett and Joe Fagnano, the two Ravens quarterbacks, and Brissett starts tonight. He needs 110.28 to stop 0‑10.

stories.title: Four weeks left, six playoff spots, and The Champ and Jefferson’s Reserve are both about to be 5‑5
stories.dek: The Champ scored 166.08 behind Joe Burrow's 409 yards. Tiebreaker is points, and TJohn91 is up 161.22 on jmello16.
body: Where it stands once tonight is over, assuming the Sunday results hold: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK 9‑1, Catfan94’s Farm Team 7‑3, Kraft for Cash 7‑3 or 6‑4, The Champ 5‑5, Jefferson’s Reserve 5‑5, Asian Jim 5‑5 or 4‑6, then I Chase Brown Kids and OBJAY at 4‑6. Six teams make it. The regular season ends in Week 14.

The Champ beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 166.08 to 55.80. Burrow had 41.16, Jared Goff 28.92, Nico Collins 22.9 and Harold Fannin Jr. 18.1. Matthew Stafford scored 25.76 on the bench and Jordyn Tyson 15.5, with Jordan Mason at 7.9 in the lineup. TJohn91 will have 1414.72 points for. Jefferson’s Reserve will have 1253.50. If it comes down to points, the two-time champ wins that.

Catfan94’s Farm Team beat OBJAY 138.94 to 83.62. Brock Purdy scored 42.16 and Amon-Ra St. Brown 25.8 with two touchdowns in Munich. jrsmith1391 started Deshaun Watson at superflex, and Watson threw for 312 yards against his old team for 21.38. Kenneth Walker III sat, Zonovan Knight scored 2.4 at flex, and it didn't matter.

OBJAY got 28.7 from Cam Skattebo and 25.7 from James Cook III, and lost Geno Smith and Omar Cooper Jr. to ankle injuries during the game. Jordan Addison missed the game and stayed in the lineup for 0.0, and Tyler Higbee scored 10.7 on the bench. Even with Higbee, JAY2913 loses by 44.62. Next week is Kraft for Cash.

feature.title: Week 9: Catfan94’s Farm Team drops 180.30, The Champ takes the bad beat, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑9
body: Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Jefferson’s Reserve 180.30 to 82.92, a 97.38-point margin and the biggest of the week. Kenneth Walker III had 36.8, Brock Purdy 31.28, Christian Watson 28.6 and Bucky Irving 27.5. jrsmith1391 is 6‑3 and has won two straight.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat The Champ 164.84 to 127.74. Jordan Love scored 42.18, Ja'Marr Chase 30.0 and Brock Bowers 24.3, and Catfan94 is 8‑1 with five wins in a row. TJohn91 had the highest losing score of the week and still lost by 37.10. Josh Jacobs scored -0.5 in the lineup, and Boutte (29.5) and Matthew Stafford (13.22) sat on the bench.

Hold My DK beat Bourbon Lover 147.12 to 86.20 behind Puka Nacua at 32.5 and Christian McCaffrey at 23.7. Kraft for Cash beat I Chase Brown Kids 121.74 to 99.86, and Asian Jim beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 86.00 to 68.34, which is the lowest score of the week. Br0phy is 0‑9.

StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte beat OBJAY 115.16 to 108.88 by 6.28, the closest game of the week. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑6 with Drake Maye at 24.76. JAY2913 had Efton Chism III on the bench with 14.4, and swapping him in for Emeka Egbuka (6.4) would have won it 116.88 to 115.16.

I'm going to be 3-7 and I'd still somehow sell my 24-year-old top scorer and a 22-year-old for a 33-year-old receiver who scored 9.9 on someone else's bench. This is how you go 10-27 all time.

columnists.name: Hugh G. Rection
columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from a basement shrine to Boston sports in pajama pants, fueled by Dunkin'. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columnists.bio: Press-box regular with a pocket square and a former linebacker's bedside manner. Blunt, polished, and always one sentence away from calling you soft.

columnists.name: Holden McGroin
columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league once. Nobody knows how. Files his columns from the porch of a trailer with a laptop he calls 'the press credential' and gives advice anyway.

columnists.bio: Covers the league from the sideline with a media pass and a spreadsheet for everything. None of her spreadsheets are correct, and she will defend every one of them.

columns.title: TWO HUNDRED THIRTY-TWO POINTS!! AGAIN!!
columns.dek: Catfan94 has the top two scores in league history. Hugh G. Rection needs a minute.
body: TWO HUNDRED THIRTY-TWO POINTS AND FIFTY-FOUR CENTS! LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix! JAHMYR GIBBS 45.2! GEORGE PICKENS 40.0! EMMETT JOHNSON 34.6, A ROOKIE IN HIS FIRST START! SIX GUYS OVER 25! I SPILLED MY DUNKIN' ON THE SHRINE!

AND HERE'S THE PART THAT MAKES ME WANT TO FLIP THE TABLE: JORDAN LOVE GOT SACKED EIGHT TIMES AND SCORED 12.8 AND IT DIDN'T MATTER! THE BENCH HAD 17.1 FROM RYAN FLOURNOY! THE BENCH WOULD HAVE BEATEN Dude, Your Getting a Dell!

MEANWHILE Kraft for Cash IS UP 5.24 ON Asian Jim WITH ONE GUY LEFT! ZAY FLOWERS AGAINST THREE CHARGERS AND RAVENS! SLEEPER SAYS Asian Jim BY 1.05! MONDAY NIGHT FOOTBALL, BABY! I'M NOT SLEEPING! I WASN'T GOING TO ANYWAY!

columns.title: Chuba Hubbard scored 35.7 on a bench. That's a coaching problem, even when you win by 100.
columns.dek: TheMoneyTeam2302 won. The film still shows a guy who didn't play the right back.
body: Hold My DK beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 179.84 to 78.92. Nobody's going to give TheMoneyTeam2302 grief for that score. I am. Jaylen Warren started and scored 7.1. Chuba Hubbard was on the bench and had 172 yards from scrimmage and two touchdowns for 35.7. That's 28.6 points left on the table.
You'll say it doesn't matter, and this week it didn't. In Week 14 it will. You don't get to pick which week your bench decides. At 9‑1, the margin for error is big. In the playoffs it's one game.
And since I'm handing out film notes, Bill_Buttlicker started Tyler Allgeier at 1.9 over Samaje Perine at 13.9 and lost by 100.92. Different situation. That one's just soft.

columns.title: 5 Monday tips from Holden McGroin, who has never once checked a Monday night lineup
columns.dek: Holden McGroin is on the porch. The laptop is at 4%. The advice is at 0%.
body: 1. Always have six quarterbacks. ZachCarroll09 does, and Cam Ward scored 24.14 on the bench. Points on the bench are points you saved for later. That's how savings work.
2. Never start the quarterback who plays on Monday. BTaylor1 started Bryce Young (8.1) and kept Justin Herbert on the bench for tonight. That way Herbert's points stay fresh.
3. Own both quarterbacks from the same team. Br0phy has Jacoby Brissett and Joe Fagnano from Baltimore. That's called a monopoly. Br0phy is 0‑9, but monopolies take time.
4. Score 116.92 and lose. paknight12 did it with Dak Prescott at 45.42. Losing with a lot of points is basically winning, according to my accountant, who is also me.
5. If your quarterback goes down, start a defensive back. Bill_Buttlicker has Travis Hunter on the taxi squad. I'm not saying it's legal. I'm saying nobody's checked.

columns.title: Catfan94 scored 232.54. My model says that's 4.17 units of Dude, Your Getting a Dell.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot built a new unit of measurement and she's going to use it all season.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix scored 232.54 and Dude, Your Getting a Dell scored 55.80. Divide one by the other and you get 4.17. So that's my new unit: one Dude, Your Getting a Dell equals 55.80 points, and I'll be using it until Br0phy scores more, which my model says is never.

Catfan94's two best weeks add up to 476.12 points, or 8.53 units of Dude, Your Getting a Dell. The best week anyone else in this league has ever had is 198.64, or 3.56 units. My model says the gap between Catfan94 and everyone else is about one entire Dude, Your Getting a Dell, plus change.

Tonight, Kraft for Cash leads Asian Jim by 5.24, or 0.094 units. Sleeper projects Asian Jim by 1.05, or 0.019 units. The confidence interval on that is 'Monday night,' which my spreadsheet doesn't have a cell for.

exits.t: Had 172 yards from scrimmage, two touchdowns and 35.7 points on the Hold My DK bench, while Jaylen Warren started and scored 7.1. Would like to be traded somewhere that counts his points.
Scored 13.9 on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench while Tyler Allgeier started and scored 1.9. The owner of this website did that. Perine has seen the website.
Scored 17.1 on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench while Jameson Williams scored 8.0 in the lineup. The team scored 232.54 without him, which somehow makes it worse.
Scored 24.14 on the bench as one of six quarterbacks on I Chase Brown Kids. Starting in a superflex league is not a crazy ask.
Scored 15.5 on The Champ's bench while Jordan Mason scored 7.9 in the lineup. A 22-year-old on a dynasty roster would like to be part of the dynasty.
Scored 14.1 on the OBJAY taxi squad, where points don't count, in a week OBJAY scored 83.62. Following Antonio Williams's lead and asking for a real roster spot.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history, and his 232.54 in Week 10 is second. Nobody else has topped 198.64.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, and scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the second-lowest score in league history.
Br0phy's 39.26 in Week 8 this year is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points.
